name: se7enxweb/tron
description: Exponential Tron, the open MCP server layer of Exponential, built on the official MCP PHP SDK: stdio and streamable HTTP transports, per-user tokens, Exponential roles and policies, an audit log, and programs (child extensions) found and loaded by convention

suggest.mcp/sdk: ^0.10: the official MCP PHP SDK as tron's protocol layer on PHP 8.2 and newer (Apache-2.0; see the README's licence section)
suggest.nyholm/psr7: ^1.8: the PSR-7 implementation the SDK's streamable HTTP transport needs
suggest.ext-mbstring: character counts and cuts by characters rather than bytes
